    Twists are coboundaries along path categories #

    For a functor F : PathCat Q ⥤ P and a twisted multiplicative basis B over P, the products of the twist along paths form a gauge (RayCat.PathCat.gauge): path categories have no contours, so every twist becomes trivial along F. With the cleaving lemma, a cleaving functor from a Euclidean path category makes an algebra with a twisted multiplicative basis representation-infinite (RayCat.PathCat.not_isRepresentationFinite_of_cleaving).
